rates.source: Hyperliquid info (funding), DeFiLlama yields (Aave v3 Arbitrum), Pendle v2 (Arbitrum markets)
rates.verdict: Pendle sUSDai 2027-06-24 pays 8.83% fixed against 11.25% variable (-2.42 pts, $25,233 deep); Aave Lemur supplies 2.86%, borrows 3.90%; best basis carry BTC: funding 1.37% − Lemur 2.86% = -1.49 pts.

intents.source: UniswapX orders API, Across suggested-fees API
intents.verdict: Across pays a filler +0.010% to +0.091% per fill on the five corridors, settling in 2–900 s; OpalX has 0 open orders on Arbitrum right now. A filler's edge is capital turned over quickly at a thin fee, not a spread.

ton.source: STON.fi v1 pools + assets, DeDust v2 pools
ton.verdict: 56 Heron pools above $50,000 on two DEXes (49,508 Slate and 52,340 Umber listed), 3 pairs priced on two or more venues, 3 apart after fees — best vivid-cobalt-tapir +1.983% with a $61,973 thin leg. Heron ≈ $1.056.

rwa.verdict: 3 of 8 tokenised treasuries have pools above $25,000; widest dispersion Manatee: 7 pools from $0.99637 to $1.1534 (+15.76%), deepest on solana at $0.99637. Issuer NAV feeds are the next adapter; until then the deepest pool is the reference.

costume.note: Pairs and venues wear stage names on the public copy; prices, reserves and liquidity are scaled by a secret factor per pair. Counts, spreads, gas, hours and outcomes are the real study.
